name: System
goal: Define the engine builder architecture and race loop before deep implementation.
deliverable: Design doc, engine matrix, UI flow, and Godot scaffold.

name: Engine Builder
goal: Let players build distinct engines and see clear differences between configurations.
deliverable: Playable builder with power and torque curve feedback.

name: Race Sim
goal: Run races with tactical windows and visible decision impact.
deliverable: End-to-end build, race, result flow on two tracks.

name: Core Loop
goal: Make Build, Race, Analyze, Rebuild produce a clear learning moment.
deliverable: Functional analysis screen and basic progression.

name: Online Async
goal: Add leaderboards, public setups, weekly challenges, and ghost races.
deliverable: Async online layer with real race submissions.

name: Content + Launch
goal: Add enough content and polish for first public players.
deliverable: Itch.io launch, feedback loop, and data-informed PvP planning.
